newsitem.title: USA: CBOE starts trading S&P 500 index-linked notes.
newsitem.headline: CBOE starts trading S&P 500 index-linked notes.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said Friday it started trading Bear Stearns S&P 500 linked notes due May 20, 2003.
The offering consisted of 1.2 million notes at $4 each.

At maturity, BSL note holders will receive the principal amount and a "supplemental redemption amount" based on the percentage increase, if any, in the S&P 500 stock index over the starting index value of 841.88, which was Thursday's close, the CBOE said. The supplemental redemption amount will not be less than zero.
O.T.A. LP is the desigated primary market maker for the BSL notes, the exchange said.
By late morning, 2,500 notes had traded at $4.
